reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified Er03 as the AEG 'liquid or object on the touch controls' cut-off, gave a precise clean-and-dry-then-power-cycle procedure matching the sensible first step, and correctly framed AEG service only as a fallback if the code persists on a dry panel, while warning not to open the hob. Conversation 1 wrongly claimed it could not identify Er03, prescribed an excessive 24-hour isolation, and padded both turns with an irrelevant 'tripping your electrics' safety panel, though it did eventually accept the homeowner's 5-minute reset and gave sensible prevention advice. Neither recommended an unjustified part, but 2 was more accurate, more efficient and more confidence-inspiring.
